name: Fuka Kouryoku
source:
29-year-old virgin Souichi meets a strange creature, Jin, who's searching for a human to carry his eggs.

If Souichi doesn't have a lover before his 30th birthday, he'll become the "mother" for Jin's offspring.

Souichi always thought he was straight, until a chance to lose his virginity comes from an unexpected source...
translation:
29岁的处男宗一遇见了正在寻找人类来承载自己卵的奇怪生物津。

如果宗一在30岁生日之前还没有恋人，他就会成为津后代的“母亲”。

宗一直以为自己是异性恋，直到一个失去童贞的机会从意料之外的来源出现……
